8 killed as bus falls into drain on Delhi-Mumbai Expressway near Kota
articles.description: In a heartbreaking incident early Saturday, a mini bus carrying 23 family members plunged into a drain en route to Khatu Shyamji temple from Bhopal. Rescue attempts were hampered by muddy conditions and water inside the drain. As of now, eight bodies have been recovered, and the injured are being promptly cared for at local hospitals. Authorities continue to work tirelessly to understand the full impact of this tragedy.

articles.title: Delhi Capitals' big IPL 2027 shake-up continues, Lanka legend joins Ganguly's team
articles.description: In an exciting development for cricket fans, Chaminda Vaas will take on the role of fast bowling coach for Delhi Capitals in the 2027 IPL season. His extensive coaching background, including tenures with Sri Lanka and Ireland, adds depth to a coaching team that also features legends Sourav Ganguly and Yuvraj Singh. The franchise is proactively enhancing its squad, highlighted by Rishabh Pant's notable return from Lucknow Super Giants.

California land trust sues to block roads across a 402-acre preserve saved from housing development
articles.description: In a bid to protect the Clover Valley nature preserve, Placer Land Trust has initiated a lawsuit to block infrastructure development attempts. Established four years ago, this cherished area has faced housing pressures in the past. It comprises ancient oak forests, wetlands, and vital archaeological sites. The conservation easement was created to enforce permanent protection, and the legal proceedings will reinforce this against any existing development rights.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: Selma Blair makes her first public appearance since arrest
articles.description: Selma Blair made her much-anticipated return to the spotlight at the 90s Con event in Hartford from October 16 to 18. This was her first appearance post-arrest on October 11, where she faced charges of allegedly assaulting a flight attendant and a police officer. Despite the legal troubles, Blair engaged warmly with fans, signing autographs and taking photos, as she maintains her not guilty plea amidst potential jail time looming.

articles.title: SS Rajamouli wants to present Ramayana differently in ‘Varanasi’
articles.description: SS Rajamouli has voiced his discontent with past interpretations of Indian epics such as the Ramayana and Mahabharata. In his upcoming film 'Varanasi,' a significant sequence inspired by the Ramayana will feature Mahesh Babu in the role of Lord Rama. Rajamouli's vision aims to convey this timeless story with grandeur and emotional resonance.

articles.description: In a candid moment on her chat show 'Double Date', Neha Dhupia revisited pivotal choices in her career, revealing her regret for declined roles in 'Chak De!
